entries.label: Id
entries.description: Preset id; must equal the file name without .worldshape.json.

entries.label: Name
entries.description: Name shown in the preset list.

entries.label: Description
entries.description: One-line summary of the world this preset makes.

entries.label: Land fraction
entries.description: Share of the map that is land.

entries.label: Continents
entries.description: Number of major landmasses.

entries.label: Islands
entries.description: Number of free-standing islands.

entries.label: Continent islands
entries.description: How much of the island budget sits close to a continent (1) versus far out (0).

entries.label: Peninsulas
entries.description: Number of peninsulas pushed out from the continents.

entries.label: Coastline
entries.description: Coast roughness: 0 smooth, 1 ragged.

entries.label: Mountainousness
entries.description: How much of the land is mountain.

entries.label: Spine to ring
entries.description: Mountain layout: 0 a single spine, 1 a ring.

entries.label: Orientation
entries.description: Direction of the main spine. Wraps into 0 to 360.

entries.label: Passes
entries.description: Number of passes cut through the mountain barrier.

entries.label: Barrier
entries.description: Strength of the barrier between the depth zones.

entries.label: Barrier form
entries.description: Shape of the barrier: a broad plateau, or a chain of volcanoes (which blocks rivers).

entries.label: Ruggedness
entries.description: Local elevation noise.

entries.label: Rivers
entries.description: River density.

entries.label: Valley depth
entries.description: How deeply rivers carve valleys.

entries.label: Lakes
entries.description: Number of inland lakes.

entries.label: Latitude north
entries.description: Latitude at the north edge of the map.

entries.label: Latitude south
entries.description: Latitude at the south edge of the map.

entries.label: Temperature offset
entries.description: Shifts every cell's temperature.

entries.label: Moisture offset
entries.description: Shifts every cell's moisture.
